name: configurator-global-validation
description: Cross-configurator validation, SEO, and website release checks.

scripts.check: npm run check:website-hydration && npm run check:website-route-isolation && npm run check:configurator-notfound && npm run check:tenant && npm run check:tenant-provisioning && npm run check:tenant-auth && npm run check:tenant-saves && npm run check:tenant-lifecycle && npm run check:tenant-subscription && npm run check:tenant-plan-changes && npm run check:tenant-usage && npm run check:analytics && npm run check:tenant-dashboard && npm run check:tenant-audit && npm run check:gas && node --check shared-ui/src/standaloneShell.js && node --check shared-ui/src/components/topBar.js && node --check roof-configurator/js/sharedShell.js
scripts.check:gas: npm run check --prefix gas-configurator && npm run build --prefix gas-configurator
scripts.check:shared-3d: node --no-warnings --experimental-vm-modules --test shared-3d/tests/material-library.mjs shared-3d/tests/renderer-quality.mjs shared-3d/tests/pergola-integration.mjs shared-3d/tests/geometry-library.mjs shared-3d/tests/geometry-integration.mjs shared-3d/tests/window-geometry-regression.mjs shared-3d/tests/edge-finishes.mjs shared-3d/tests/edge-integration.mjs shared-3d/tests/contact-shading.mjs shared-3d/tests/pbr-textures.mjs shared-3d/tests/uv-mapping.mjs shared-3d/tests/uv-integration.mjs shared-3d/tests/render-performance.mjs shared-3d/tests/polymer-materials.mjs shared-3d/tests/polymer-preservation.mjs shared-3d/tests/pergola-materials.mjs shared-3d/tests/pergola-materials-preservation.mjs
scripts.check:shared-3d:pbr-browser: npm run prepare:static --prefix window-configurator && node shared-3d/tests/pbr-browser.mjs
scripts.check:shared-3d:polymer-browser: npm run prepare:static --prefix window-configurator && node shared-3d/tests/polymer-browser.mjs
